newsitem.title: GERMANY: German banks' league table -- Deutsche still leads.
newsitem.headline: German banks' league table -- Deutsche still leads.

text.p: Deutsche Bank AG will remain the largest German commercial bank in terms of total assets even after the proposed merger of two Bavarian banks -- Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Bayerische Hypotheken und- Wechselbank AG -- according to balance sheet data.
But the new merged bank, Bayerische Hypo- und Vereinsbank AG, will supplant Dresdner Bank as Germany's second largest listed bank.
The following details on the size of German commercial banks are taken from their 1996 annual reports.
Details on Bayerische Hypo- und Vereinsbank AG (BHV) -- poised to become number two in the market -- come from a proforma combined 1996 balance sheet issued by the two banks.
Assets and credit volume figures are in billions of marks.
NOTE - The staff and branches figures for BHV are added together from figures for the two separate banks. Job cuts and bank closures are a likely consequence of the merger.
